item.text:
It is **Upgrade 04**, “Cold Climate Air-Source Heat Pump.” The release README’s upgrade table maps it to the report *ResStock Measure Documentation: Cold Climate Air-Source Heat Pump*. ([Release README, p. 9](https://oedi-data-lake.s3.amazonaws.com/nrel-pds-building-stock/end-use-load-profiles-for-us-building-stock/2025/resstock_amy2018_release_1/README_resstock_20251.pdf))

The report is by **Philip White and Andrew Parker (2026)**, report **NLR/TP-5500-96413**, DOI **10.2172/3365374**. ([Official report record](https://research-hub.nlr.gov/en/publications/resstock-measure-documentation-cold-climate-air-source-heat-pump/))
